about: Hello, my name is Aditya Rizal Hendrawan. I am an Electrical Engineering Technology Student at Universitas Gadjah Mada and graduate from SMKN 2 Yogyakarta with experience in the Internet of Things (IoT) field.  I possess a foundational understanding of microcontroller programming using the Arduino IDE, as well as practical experience working with ESP8266, ESP32, and Mappi32 modules, sensors, and actuators to develop IoT-based systems. I have completed industrial internships at IoT technology companies (KMTek and Mertani).
